# miniaudio_libsndfile

A custom decoding backend for [miniaudio](https://miniaud.io) that delegates audio file I/O to [libsndfile](https://libsndfile.github.io/libsndfile/), extending miniaudio's built-in WAV/FLAC/MP3 support to cover a much wider range of formats.

> **Source code generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6.**  
> Licensed under the [MIT License](#license).

---

## Supported Formats

Any format that libsndfile can read is automatically available, including (but not limited to):

| Format | Extensions |
|--------|-----------|
| WAV / RF64 / W64 | `.wav`, `.rf64`, `.w64` |
| AIFF / AIFC | `.aiff`, `.aif` |
| Sun AU / NeXT SND | `.au`, `.snd` |
| FLAC | `.flac` |
| Ogg Vorbis | `.ogg` |
| CAF (Core Audio) | `.caf` |
| Raw PCM | `.raw` |
| VOC, SVX, PAF, MAT, PVF, HTK, SDS, SD2, AVR, XI, MPC, REX2 | various |

For the full list see the [libsndfile documentation](https://libsndfile.github.io/libsndfile/formats.html).

## Requirements

- **miniaudio** ≥ 0.11 (single-header or split build)
- **libsndfile** ≥ 1.0 — install via your system package manager:
  ```sh
  # Debian / Ubuntu
  sudo apt install libsndfile1-dev

  # macOS (Homebrew)
  brew install libsndfile

  # Fedora / RHEL
  sudo dnf install libsndfile-devel
  ```

---

## How It Works

### Architecture

miniaudio supports pluggable decoding backends through `ma_decoding_backend_vtable`.  
`miniaudio_libsndfile` implements this vtable and hooks libsndfile into miniaudio's standard decoder pipeline.

```
ma_decoder_init_file()
        │
        ▼
ma_decoding_backend_vtable   ←── miniaudio_libsndfile registers here
        │
        ▼
ma_libsndfile  (wraps SNDFILE*)
        │
        ▼
libsndfile  (reads/decodes the file)
        │
        ▼
Interleaved PCM frames  ──► miniaudio device callback
```

### Two Initialisation Paths

| Function | When used | Underlying libsndfile call |
|---|---|---|
| `ma_libsndfile_init_file()` | `ma_decoder_init_file()` — file path known | `sf_open(path, SFM_READ, ...)` |
| `ma_libsndfile_init()` | `ma_decoder_init()` — custom I/O stream | `sf_open_virtual(&sfvio, ...)` |

For most playback use cases `init_file` is all that is needed.  
`init` (virtual I/O mode) bridges miniaudio's `ma_read_proc` / `ma_seek_proc` / `ma_tell_proc` callbacks to libsndfile's `SF_VIRTUAL_IO` struct.

### PCM Output

libsndfile's `sf_readf_*` family produces **interleaved** frames directly, so no manual de-interleaving step is required (unlike some other backends).

| `ma_format` | libsndfile call |
|---|---|
| `ma_format_f32` (default) | `sf_readf_float()` |
| `ma_format_s16` | `sf_readf_short()` |
| `ma_format_s32` | `sf_readf_int()` |

## Usage

### 1. Add files to your project

Copy `miniaudio_libsndfile.h` and `miniaudio_libsndfile.c` next to your source, then include them **after** miniaudio:

```c
/* In one .c file only: */
#include "miniaudio.c"             /* or #define MINIAUDIO_IMPLEMENTATION */
#include "miniaudio_libsndfile.c"
```

```c
/* In any header or file that uses the decoder: */
#include "miniaudio.h"
#include "miniaudio_libsndfile.h"
```

### 2. Register the backend

```c
ma_decoding_backend_vtable* pCustomBackendVTables[] = {
    ma_decoding_backend_libsndfile
};

ma_decoder_config config = ma_decoder_config_init_default();
config.ppCustomBackendVTables = pCustomBackendVTables;
config.customBackendCount     = 1;
```

> **Built-in decoder coexistence**: miniaudio tries custom backends first, then automatically falls
> back to its built-in WAV / FLAC / MP3 decoders if all custom backends return a failure. You do
> **not** need to do anything special — registering only libsndfile is enough to cover both
> libsndfile-exclusive formats and the formats that miniaudio can already handle natively.
> For AIFF, CAF, W64, and other libsndfile-exclusive formats, libsndfile wins. For WAV/FLAC/MP3,
> libsndfile also handles them correctly, so the result is identical either way.

### 3. Open a file and play it

```c
ma_decoder decoder;
ma_result result = ma_decoder_init_file("sound.aiff", &config, &decoder);
if (result != MA_SUCCESS) {
    printf("Failed to open file.\n");
    return -1;
}

ma_device_config deviceConfig = ma_device_config_init(ma_device_type_playback);
deviceConfig.playback.format   = decoder.outputFormat;
deviceConfig.playback.channels = decoder.outputChannels;
deviceConfig.sampleRate        = decoder.outputSampleRate;
deviceConfig.dataCallback      = data_callback;
deviceConfig.pUserData         = &decoder;

ma_device device;
ma_device_init(NULL, &deviceConfig, &device);
ma_device_start(&device);

printf("Press Enter to quit...");
getchar();

ma_device_uninit(&device);
ma_decoder_uninit(&decoder);
```

The `data_callback` is identical to any standard miniaudio example:

```c
void data_callback(ma_device* pDevice, void* pOutput, const void* pInput, ma_uint32 frameCount)
{
    ma_decoder* pDecoder = (ma_decoder*)pDevice->pUserData;
    if (pDecoder == NULL) return;
    ma_decoder_read_pcm_frames(pDecoder, pOutput, frameCount, NULL);
    (void)pInput;
}
```

### 4. Compile

```sh
gcc -o player player.c -I/path/to/miniaudio -lsndfile -ldl -lm -lpthread
# or with pkg-config:
gcc -o player player.c $(pkg-config --cflags --libs sndfile) -ldl -lm -lpthread
```

## Advanced Usage

### Preferred sample format

```c
ma_decoder_config config = ma_decoder_config_init(ma_format_s16, 2, 44100);
config.ppCustomBackendVTables = pCustomBackendVTables;
config.customBackendCount     = 1;
```

Supported preferred formats: `ma_format_f32` (default), `ma_format_s16`, `ma_format_s32`.

### Disable the backend at compile time

Define `MA_NO_LIBSNDFILE` to exclude the implementation.  
`ma_decoding_backend_libsndfile` will be `NULL`, and miniaudio will skip it silently when iterating backends.

```sh
gcc -DMA_NO_LIBSNDFILE ...
```

### Virtual I/O (custom stream)

If the audio data is not on disk (e.g. a network stream or in-memory buffer), provide your own `ma_read_proc`, `ma_seek_proc`, and `ma_tell_proc`, then call:

```c
ma_libsndfile sndfile;
ma_libsndfile_init(onRead, onSeek, onTell, pUserData, &config, NULL, &sndfile);
```

`onTell` is **mandatory** in virtual I/O mode because libsndfile's virtual layer requires it to determine the file length and to return the new position after each seek.

## API Reference

```c
/* Initialise from callbacks (virtual I/O) */
ma_result ma_libsndfile_init(
    ma_read_proc onRead, ma_seek_proc onSeek, ma_tell_proc onTell,
    void* pReadSeekTellUserData,
    const ma_decoding_backend_config* pConfig,
    const ma_allocation_callbacks* pAllocationCallbacks,
    ma_libsndfile* pSndfile);

/* Initialise from a file path */
ma_result ma_libsndfile_init_file(
    const char* pFilePath,
    const ma_decoding_backend_config* pConfig,
    const ma_allocation_callbacks* pAllocationCallbacks,
    ma_libsndfile* pSndfile);

void      ma_libsndfile_uninit(ma_libsndfile* pSndfile, const ma_allocation_callbacks*);

ma_result ma_libsndfile_read_pcm_frames(ma_libsndfile*, void* pOut, ma_uint64 frameCount, ma_uint64* pRead);
ma_result ma_libsndfile_seek_to_pcm_frame(ma_libsndfile*, ma_uint64 frameIndex);
ma_result ma_libsndfile_get_data_format(ma_libsndfile*, ma_format*, ma_uint32* ch, ma_uint32* sr, ma_channel*, size_t);
ma_result ma_libsndfile_get_cursor_in_pcm_frames(ma_libsndfile*, ma_uint64* pCursor);
ma_result ma_libsndfile_get_length_in_pcm_frames(ma_libsndfile*, ma_uint64* pLength);

/* Plug into ma_decoder_config.ppCustomBackendVTables */
extern ma_decoding_backend_vtable* ma_decoding_backend_libsndfile;
```
